approved_translation: Kindness and gentle speech win loyalty; harsh words drive friends away.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time a king had an Elephant named Girly-face. The Elephant was called Girly-face because he was so gentle and good and looked so kind. I must hurt no one. I must not kill any one." And from that time on Girly-face was tame and as good as ever an Elephant could be.
